description: This file contains benchmark classes for various neural network operations such as cross-entropy, softmax, RMS normalization, and layer normalization, including their forward and backward passes, with support for multiple backends and dynamic shape handling.

classes.name: CrossEntropyForward
classes.description: Benchmark class for forward pass of cross-entropy operation with multiple backends.

classes.name: CrossEntropyBackward
classes.description: Benchmark class for backward pass of cross-entropy operation with multiple backends.

classes.name: SoftmaxForward
classes.description: Benchmark class for forward pass of softmax operation with multiple backends.

classes.name: SoftmaxBackward
classes.description: Benchmark class for backward pass of softmax operation with multiple backends.

classes.name: RMSNormForward
classes.description: Benchmark class for forward pass of RMS normalization with multiple backends.

classes.name: RMSNormBackward
classes.description: Benchmark class for backward pass of RMS normalization with multiple backends.

classes.name: LayerNormForward
classes.description: Benchmark class for forward pass of layer normalization with multiple backends.

classes.name: LayerNormBackward
classes.description: Benchmark class for backward pass of layer normalization with multiple backends.

methods.name: get_shapes
methods.description: Returns a tuple of shape tuples used for benchmarking.

methods.name: get_memory_bytes
methods.description: Calculates memory usage in bytes for given input arguments.

methods.name: eager
methods.description: Defines the eager execution mode for the operation.

methods.name: compiled
methods.description: Defines the compiled mode for the operation using torch.compile.

methods.name: quack
methods.description: Defines the quack backend implementation for the operation.

methods.name: liger
methods.description: Defines the liger backend implementation for the operation.

methods.name: benchmark
methods.description: Runs benchmarking over different shapes and backends.

methods.name: check_accuracy
methods.description: Checks the accuracy of different backends against eager reference.
